text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit westbound U-turns at all times on Elmbrook Crescent, between Renforth Drive (south intersection) and Millsborough Crescent. This proposed prohibition, requested by an area resident, will address traffic safety concerns and congestion in the area.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited westbound U-turn movements at all times on Elmbrook Crescent, between Renforth Drive (south intersection) and Millsborough Crescent.
